description: This is a PHP source file for the 'Edit View' page of the Quotes module in a CRM system, probably vTiger. It handles setting up the environment, retrieving and preparing data for editing or duplicating a quote, managing associated products, account details, and rendering the corresponding Smarty templates for creating or editing quotes.
